description: This source file defines a React hook `useProgressiveExpand` and a utility function `createProgressiveExpandController`. The module facilitates progressive, batched processing of work items in a non-blocking way, compatible with React components. It manages progress, cancellation, and adapts to the availability of `requestIdleCallback` for efficient batching.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller object to manage batched, progressive processing of items, using `requestIdleCallback` if available, with fallback to `setTimeout`. Supports starting, canceling, and progress tracking.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: A React hook that wraps `createProgressiveExpandController` to manage UI state and progress within React components. It allows starting the process with a set of items and supports cancellation and progress monitoring.
